ctxFrame.title: CTX Frame
ctxFrame.description: A workflow for making intentional product context a first-class artifact — structured, versioned, and readable by any AI before it writes a single line of code.

ctxBanner.title: The AI reads your code. Not your intent.
ctxBanner.description: I built CTX Frame because technically correct code kept breaking product decisions nobody wrote down. The diff looked clean. The intent was wrong. CTX Frame gives intentional context a permanent home in the repository.
ctxBanner.learnMore: Explore the Thinking Behind CTX Frame

ctxConcept.title: Context before code. Always.
ctxConcept.description: The unit of work is a change in intentional context — not a prompt, not a commit. The AI reads that change and translates it to code within the guardrails the context defines.
